# Vendored libraries

Copied as released, so the apps load nothing from other servers (only Carte's map tiles do).

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `leaflet/` | [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD 2-Clause |
| `cytoscape.min.js` | [Cytoscape.js](https://js.cytoscape.org) | 3.30.2 | MIT |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://stuk.github.io/jszip/) | 3.10.1 | MIT (dual MIT / GPLv3) |
| `togeojson.umd.js` | [@tmcw/togeojson](https://github.com/placemark/togeojson) | 5.8.1 | BSD 2-Clause |

Leaflet, Cytoscape.js and JSZip came from cdnjs. toGeoJSON came from unpkg.
